body.name: Fixed-query product-experiment ordered-modulus handle
body.construction: At a fixed admissible query \(z_0\), solve the ordered-modulus problem for the product of the treated-mean, bounded replicated-regression, realized-design, and full-covariance donor-location experiments induced by \(\mathbb P_{z_0}\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0)\).  Invert the resulting least-favorable tests using either the whole unit history as the stochastic coordinate or a valid deterministic product-experiment test.  No calendar-block score, response-block independence, or conditioning on a query-null version is part of this handle.
